mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits amphetamine metabolism and increases sympathomimetic effects, while amphetamine increases norepinephrine and dopamine release, creating risk of hypertensive crisis, arrhythmias, and hyperthermia.
action: This combination is contraindicated; do not use together. Allow minimum 14 days washout after MAOI discontinuation before starting amphetamine, or 5 half-lives after amphetamine before starting MAOI.
